## Chillscreen: CD spines with the artists
- **Real CD spines:** the stacked CD cases in the room now show the artist in bold and the song title on their spine, taken from your queue (on the website from the demo songs), like real CDs. When the queue changes, the spines change with it

The room on the website got the same update.

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new installer
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates
